enhanced_cards.headline: Exclusive Event Coverage Gives Readers Front‑Row Industry Insights
enhanced_cards.what_readers_get: Live floor reports, keynote takeaways, and networking highlights you won’t find elsewhere.
enhanced_cards.why_it_matters: Conferences set the agenda for iGaming, so timely intel drives strategic decisions.
enhanced_cards.evidence_summary: Event stories make up 91% of our output versus 31% for competitors (2.95‑times higher focus).

result.strategic_summary: We turn iGaming events into a must‑read source of actionable intelligence.

result.timing_note: Begin outreach immediately (next 2‑3 weeks) to secure early‑bird booth rates and align with product launch calendars; high‑urgency prospects (Sportsbet, Kenya Gaming Board, Nigeria SEC) should be contacted within the next 5 business days.
